Author: G.R.Swaminathan

 4.The Inspector of Police,
 C-2 Police Station  (Subramaniapuram Police Station),
 Madurai. ... Res  Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorari, to call for the e  records from the second respondent impugned order No. Na.Ka.No.
 0290A2/2024/U.Paa.A dated 14.02.2024 and quash the same. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.R.Ramasamy  For Respondents : Mr.Veera.Kathiravan  Additional Advocate General  Assisted by Mr.T.Villavan Koth  Additional Government Pleader  for R.1 to R.3  Mr.A.Albert James  Government Advocate (Criminal  for R.4  ORDER Heard both sides. 
2.The petitioner's shop has been sealed for breach of FSSAI Act. 
I do not want to go into the jurisdictional aspects. This is because the Hon'ble Division Bench is seized of the matter and an interim order has https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis also been granted in the appeal filed by the State. The petitioner's shop was sealed on 14.02.2024. More than a month has elapsed. 
3.The learned Additional Advocate General points out that the petitioner after given a solemn undertaking before this Court had breached the same and that therefore the writ petition deserves dismissal. 
4.This submission of the learned Additional Advocate General undoubtedly a merits acceptance. But taking note of the fact that the petitioner's shop has been sealed for more than 40 days and since the petitioner has to face prosecution if he does not compound the offence, I am inclined to grant relief.
The petitioner is warned that if he is caught again, he may lose the license to conduct his business even. The learned Additional Advocate General also informs this Court that the petitioner's registration has been cancelled. 
D.Muthupandi vs The Commissioner on 25 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115654817/
2 5.In these circumstances, the shop need not continue to remain sealed. I direct the respondents to deseal the petition mentioned shop. I do so and give this direction without setting aside the impugned order. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 6.This writ petition is allowed on these terms. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
